adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sharp, sustained offset at index 612 (N +14, E -4, U -12 MAD) that persists through index 615 with no return; the interior (613–615) remains displaced and noisy but does not revert toward pre-offset levels. Hypotheses P1 and P2 both subtract the same onset offset, yet residuals still show a step-like discontinuity without recovery—indicating a permanent step, not a temporary platform. No opposing return is observed on any axis across the interval. P1 (single-day) is too short to be a platform; P2 (4-day) lacks closure. Physical motion continues post-615 but at new baseline. Thus, no genuine temporary offset exists.
